validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED (high). P7714 is Line 1 of Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 3 (Eastern Region Pipeline). Two INDEPENDENT sources name it explicitly and agree on the key specs: (1) the LAIC/Lamar Industrial contractor project page (the sheet's own Status/Length/Diameter ref) describes 'Line 1: 56-inch, ~150 km, EWPS #1 to BGCS #3, designated SRG-3' and 'Line 2: 56-inch, ~40 km, BGCS #3 to KM 245.2, designated SRG-2 SEC III' — i.e. P7714 and P7715 respectively; (2) DMS Projects' dedicated 'MGSE Phase 2 - Package 3 - Eastern Region Pipeline' page (PRJ00021820) states 'construction of 150 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas Pipeline 3 as well as 40 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the Shedgum Riyadh Gas 2', Status 'Completed', sponsor Saudi Aramco. GEM's PipelineName ('...Pipeline 3'), OtherEnglishNames ('EWPS1- BGCS 3'), LengthKnown (150 km) and Diameter (56 in) all line up with these. CLASSIFICATION — CONFIRMED: this is a 56-inch Master Gas System sales-gas trunk line (transmission, Fuel=Gas), correctly on GGIT; not gathering/plant-internal/oil. DUPLICATE — checked, NOT a duplicate. It is not the same as P7715 (that is the distinct 40 km Line 2 / SRG-2 of the same package). It is also not a duplicate of the MGS III construction rows P6719/P6720 ('EWPS-1-EWPS-3 "3"/"4"', 150 km, 56 in, SY 2028): those are NEW parallel lines 3 and 4 being laid along the same corridor for Phase 3 (construction, ~2028) — a genuine naming collision (both use '3'/'4') but a different phase and different physical pipe. SPEC — Length 150 km and Diameter 56 in CONFIRMED by both independent sources. StartYear1=2021 is defensible: LAIC lists its Engineering/Procurement sub-scope as 'Awarded 2015, Completed 2018', but the overall MGS-2 EPC (main pipeline packages, Arkad E&C) was completed in 2021 raising MGS capacity from 8.4 to 12.5 bcf/d; commissioning ~2021 is reasonable (minor caveat, not an error). SegmentCost=$255M is defensible: DMS gives the whole Package 3 budget as ~$372M, and P7714 $255M + P7715 $117M = $372M, so the split is internally consistent (the metenders ref did not surface the exact $255M string, and LAIC's $118.53M is its EP-only sub-scope, so cost is corroborated at package level but the exact $255M line-split is single-source — low). ATTRIBUTION caveat: Owner is blank ('--') though sibling MGS-2 rows P7711/P7712 carry Aramco [100.%] and both sources confirm Saudi Aramco as owner/operator — fill provided.

routes.corridor_desc: SRG-3 runs ~150 km of 56-inch line westward from EWPS-1 (start of the East-West pipelines corridor, adjacent to the Shedgum Gas Plant / UBTG-1 scraper station in the Ghawar area of Eastern Province, approx. 25.55N 49.30E) along the EXISTING East-West Pipelines (Master Gas System) corridor to Booster Gas Compression Station BGCS-3. BGCS-# stations are co-located with the numbered EWPS pump stations along the Shedgum->Yanbu corridor (cf. GulfPub/MEED 'EWPS-10 / BGCS-10'), so BGCS-3 sits ~150 km WNW of EWPS-1, roughly toward the 26.1N 47.9E area on the corridor heading toward the Riyadh/Yanbu axis. Start endpoint is defensible from the named Shedgum Gas Plant location (medium); the end endpoint (BGCS-3) is named but not independently geolocated, so its lat/lon are left null rather than fabricated. Tightest defensible bound: a ~150 km corridor beginning at the Shedgum area and following the established East-West MGS right-of-way westward.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the LAIC contractor page (EWPS-1 -> BGCS-3, SRG-3, 150 km, 56 in) and corroborated as a Phase-2 Package-3 line by DMS. Start coordinate approximated to the named Shedgum Gas Plant / EWPS-1 location in the Ghawar area; end (BGCS-3) not independently geolocated so lat/lon left null. No coordinates were fabricated. Route follows the pre-existing East-West MGS corridor, so a routes-repo editor could trace it along the existing corridor geometry.
